# Diagnosis playbook

Doctrine 0.1.0. The decisions the brain is asked, materiality, symptom to lever.

## When a signal is worth acting on

| Signal | Material when |
|---|---|
| EC drift | Settled pore EC sustained above about 1.2x or below about 0.8x the active phase target across the recent trend, not one reading (ec_adjust already corrects single spikes). |
| Overnight dryback off arc | The zone's observed overnight dryback (the day's peak to the trough before lights-on, relative to the zone's own peak, as code converts it) sits outside the selected arc's band for the stage on more than one night. dryback_target is not this number (DRY-02). |
| Cross-zone under-drinker | A zone under 40% of the cross-zone median daily volume while the median is at least 5 L. Investigate first; usually hardware. |
| Phase stuck | P1 ends only by maximum shots (target above the achievable peak), or P0 ends by the bypass at lights-on (the zone came out of the night at or under its re-water threshold). P0 ending on its timeout is normal whenever dryback_target is larger than the morning drop (DRY-10). |
| Safety / lockout | Pore EC at maximum EC with a non-dilutive feed; feed out of band while a zone needs water; a dead or blind probe; a probe that stays high while the zone gets no water past the ramp (PRB-08); the minimum daily floor missed where one is configured. |
| Over-water | With Auto Setpoints off: VWC at or above the grower's field capacity for a sustained period, or a sustained over_saturated status. With it on (always so when a notch is asked), field capacity is the zone's own highest reading, so each new high over this grow-day and the one before reads over_saturated, and the hours within 5 points of it approaching_saturation (CT-14): those labels are not material. Over-water then means the zone held near its peak through P2 with the observed overnight dryback under the arc's band on more than one night, or runoff above the stage's band, or pore EC washing out below its band. |
| Targets following the probe | With Auto Setpoints on: field capacity, and with it the re-water threshold, moving a point a grow-day for several grow-days (most of all downward) while shots, climate and sibling zones are unchanged. Raise it for a person as suspected probe drift (PRB-14); never answer it with a notch. |

Not material: hold. Two candidates on the same lever: one decision. Already handled by the engine: hold.

## Symptom -> lever

`ACTS` = an answer the brain may give, named by its decision and answer key; code and the envelope do the rest. `ADVISES` = a recommendation for a person. Symptom entries carry no evidence class of their own: they are product-rule, drawn from the decision rules and engine facts they cite.

### SYM-01 Settled pore EC running high, sustained

Rule out first: Feed EC near or above pore EC (cannot dilute), or the zone not draining.

- `ACTS` p2_shot_size up via `setpoints: bigger_shots`: More runoff per shot carries salt out, when the feed is dilutive and the zone drains.
- `ACTS` p2_threshold up via `setpoints: sooner_rewater`: Wetter floor, more top-ups, more runoff.
- `ACTS` EC steer steer via `salt: salts_accumulating, salt_front_passing`: With stacking on, the base steer raises the threshold against high EC: keep it steering.
- `ADVISES` ec_target_p2 down: Only when the target itself is wrong for the stage; a person's setting.
- `ADVISES` feed EC down (slow): Only when the feed is too close to pore EC.
- Never: Raise max_ec to stop a flush.

### SYM-02 Pore EC low or washing out, generative push wanted

Rule out first: Over-flushing: check runoff share and maintenance shot size.

- `ACTS` p2_shot_size down via `setpoints: smaller_shots`: Less runoff, so EC builds.
- `ACTS` p2_threshold down via `setpoints: later_rewater`: Drier between shots, fewer top-ups; salt concentrates.
- `ADVISES` stacking_on on: Lets the threshold drop when EC is under 90% of target, so EC builds.
- Never: Raise dryback_target to stack EC: it does not deepen the overnight dryback (DRY-02).

### SYM-03 Overnight dryback too small for the stage (too vegetative)

Rule out first: Compare the observed overnight dryback (code's figure) with the arc band; a late top-up or a zone held wet by P2 until lights-off. P0's timeout is not this symptom.

- `ACTS` P2 -> P3 (day's last shot) earlier via `dusk: enter_p3_now`: The last shot sets the overnight dryback; generative zones only, last 3 h, well above the rescue floor.
- `ACTS` p2_threshold down via `setpoints: later_rewater`: The zone goes into the night drier.
- Never: Raise dryback_target to deepen the overnight dryback: it does not set it, and a larger value can switch the predictive P3 off (DRY-02).

### SYM-04 Overnight dryback too large, plants stressed or wilting

Rule out first: Missed shot or demand change (light, VPD, CO2, airflow).

- `ADVISES` P2 -> P3 (day's last shot) later: Answering continue_p2 only declines to end the day early; it cannot hold back the engine's own hand-over to P3. Watering later than the engine would is not a brain lever.
- `ACTS` p2_threshold up via `setpoints: sooner_rewater`: The zone goes into the night wetter.
- `ADVISES` p3_emergency_floor up: Catches the overnight fall earlier. Raising a safety floor is a person's call; lowering it is never advised.
- Never: Lower dryback_target to shrink the overnight dryback: it does not set it (DRY-02).

### SYM-05 P1 ends only at maximum shots (never reads full)

Rule out first: Target above the achievable peak (compare detected Vmax), blocked dripper, wrong flow or substrate config. With Auto Setpoints on the target is the zone's highest reading of the grow-day before, so a ramp that keeps stopping at maximum shots fell short of yesterday's peak: delivery or probe first.

- `ACTS` P1 -> P2 earlier via `ramp: slab_full`: When the curve shows the slab full (shots no longer lift the retained reading), hand over.
- `ADVISES` p1_target down: With Auto Setpoints off, a person sets it toward the detected Vmax or the zone's recent peaks. With it on, code already sets it from yesterday's peak and an edit does not stick: advise on the cause, or on turning the switch off, not on the number.

### SYM-06 Zone drying fast in P2, frequent top-ups

Rule out first: Shot-size units misconfigured (substrate per plant x plant count vs zone flow): check the pump on-seconds against the expected duration.

- `ACTS` p2_shot_size up via `setpoints: bigger_shots`: Bigger top-ups, fewer cycles.
- `ACTS` p2_threshold up via `setpoints: sooner_rewater`: Wetter floor.

### SYM-07 Over-watered: the zone stays near its peak through P2, its observed overnight dryback runs under the arc's band, runoff runs above the stage's band, or (Auto Setpoints off) VWC sits over the grower's field capacity for long spells

Rule out first: Dripper stuck open or a valve not closing; with Auto Setpoints off, field_capacity set above the true full mark. With it on, field capacity is the zone's own highest reading, so reading at it, over_saturated or approaching_saturation is the zone at its own peak, not over-watering (CT-14).

- `ACTS` p2_threshold down via `setpoints: later_rewater`: Fewer top-ups.
- `ACTS` p2_shot_size down via `setpoints: smaller_shots`: Less water per top-up.
- `ADVISES` p1_target down: With Auto Setpoints off, a peak above the true full mark only drains. With it on, code sets the target from yesterday's peak: fix the delivery, not the number.
- Never: Notch drier on an over_saturated or approaching_saturation label alone while Auto Setpoints is on: each new high reads that way by construction (CT-14).

### SYM-08 Cross-zone under-drinker

Rule out first: Probe reading low but alive, valve or dripper partly blocked, delivery fault. Lead with investigate.

- `ADVISES` investigate: Catch test; compare probe with siblings.
- `ADVISES` p2_shot_size up: Only after hardware is ruled out, and only as a person's setting for that zone.

### SYM-09 Daily budget reached

Rule out first: Is it runoff waste?

- `ACTS` p2_shot_size down via `setpoints: smaller_shots`: If water is running to waste.
- `ACTS` p2_threshold down via `setpoints: later_rewater`: Fewer top-ups.
- `ADVISES` max_daily_volume up: Only for genuine demand; a person decides.

### SYM-10 Runoff high while VWC barely rises

Rule out first: Channeling, a dry core or poor block contact.

- `ADVISES` investigate: Inspect; rewet slowly or by hand. Adding volume does not fix it.

### SYM-11 Pore EC rising right after a flush

Rule out first: Feed dilutive and the zone draining?

- `ACTS` p2_shot_size up via `setpoints: bigger_shots`: The salt front is still passing; it was not flushed to saturation.
- `ACTS` EC steer steer via `salt: salt_front_passing`: The salt front is passing, not a probe fault: keep steering.

### SYM-12 P0 ends on its timeout every morning

Rule out first: dryback_target larger than the drop a morning gives (the integration's defaults are); that is the setting, not a fault.

- `ACTS` P0 -> P1 earlier via `dawn: start_ramp_now`: Start the ramp when the plants are drinking and the slab has dried a little since lights-on.
- `ADVISES` dryback_target down: A person may set it near the morning drop (vendor figure: 1-5 % relative); it also changes the predictive P3 test.
- `ADVISES` p0_max_wait_min: The latest the ramp may start.

### SYM-13 Probe stuck high or not answering the shots

Rule out first: Are shots firing and landing? Do the sibling zones rise?

- `ACTS` probe trust set aside via `probe: no`: The shots show it is not tracking: say no; code confirms before it sets the probe aside.
- `ADVISES` investigate: Reseat or replace the probe; catch-test the zone.
- Never: Call a probe sound because no other reading disagrees: on a default install, past the morning ramp, nothing else waters a zone whose probe keeps reading high (PRB-08).

### SYM-14 EC steer chasing a target it cannot reach, or a jumpy EC reading

Rule out first: Has pore EC ever been near the target on this feed? Do the EC readings move with the moisture?

- `ACTS` EC steer decay via `salt: target_unreachable, probe_suspect`: Let the offset fall back rather than shrink or stretch the shots.
- `ADVISES` ec_target_p2: Set the target to what this feed and slab can reach.

## Engine parameter -> integration setting

Engine parameter (ZoneParams) -> the integration setting it is read from. Setting keys are product keys, not site entity ids. Mode-split settings resolve by the zone's steering mode (vegetative or generative). The brain moves only p2_shot_size and the base p2_vwc_threshold, one notch a grow-day (ACT-07). With the room's Auto Setpoints switch on (opt-in, and always on when a notch is asked) code also writes field_capacity and p1_target_vwc from the zone's own highest readings and shifts p2_vwc_threshold and p3_emergency_vwc_threshold with field capacity (CT-12, CT-13). Every other row is the grower's setting, and the brain's view of any row it does not notch is advice.

| engine | setting |
|---|---|
| p1_target | p1_target_vwc (with Auto Setpoints on, set by code to the zone's highest reading of the grow-day before) |
| p2_threshold | p2_vwc_threshold (with Auto Setpoints on, shifted with field capacity), plus the controller's EC offset whenever pore EC is known (the offset moves only while EC stacking is on, and keeps applying after stacking is switched off until the lights-on reset) (clamped to rescue floor + 3 .. min(p1_target, field_capacity) - 1) |
| p2_shot_size | p2_shot_size (% of substrate) |
| p1_initial | p1_initial_shot_size (% of substrate) |
| p1_incr | p1_shot_size_increment (% per shot) |
| p1_max_shots | p1_maximum_shots |
| p1_min_shots | p1_minimum_shots |
| p1_time_between_min | p1_time_between_shots (min) |
| dryback_target | vegetative_dryback_target | generative_dryback_target (relative %; compared with P0's drop since lights-on and in the predictive P3 test, never with the overnight dryback; the integration's separate p0_dryback_drop_percent is not read by the controller) |
| p0_max_wait_min | p0_maximum_wait_time (min) |
| ec_target_p0/p1/p2 | ec_target_veg_p0..p2 | ec_target_gen_p0..p2 |
| p3_emergency_floor | p3_emergency_vwc_threshold (the rescue floor; with Auto Setpoints on, shifted with field capacity, down as well as up, and lowered to stay 3 points under the threshold) |
| p3_emergency_shot | p3_emergency_shot_size |
| max_daily_volume | max_daily_volume (L per zone per grow-day) |
| min_daily_volume | no integration setting: a per-zone helper the install creates by hand (min_daily_ml_per_plant) x the zone's plant_count / 1000. Absent on a fresh install, so the floor is 0 (off); the controller also sets it to 0 for a zone whose table is backing up |
| field_capacity | field_capacity (with Auto Setpoints on, set by code to the zone's highest reading of this grow-day or the one before) |
| max_ec | maximum_ec |
| stacking_on | ec_stacking_enabled (room switch) |
| watchdog_hours | watchdog_hours |
| drown_ceiling | an optional per-zone number min_floor_drown_ceiling the install creates by hand (the integration creates none); default 90 |
| p2_min_interval_min | fixed 10 min (no setting) |
| min_floor_finish_h | fixed 3 h (no setting) |
